baseline.note: Not green. All 9 failures are one parametrized test across 9 providers, outside this feature's file scope.
baseline.cause: The test expects FailureClass.UNKNOWN, the classification produced when a provider extra is absent and no client can be built. On this machine every provider instead reached the network and returned a real classified failure (TRANSIENT connection-refused, or AUTH). google_gemini returned 'API key not valid' from the live endpoint, so egress and at least one key are present here. The test's premise is CI's environment (no egress, no credentials), not this host.
baseline.side_observation: That test performs real outbound calls to third-party LLM endpoints during make verify. Out of scope for this wave; worth raising separately.
baseline.decision: Characterized as known-red and pinned. T023 must reproduce exactly these 9 and no others; any additional failure is this feature's defect.
